purpose: Reproducible host-side ONNX export and three-path parity policy for the bounded landmark experiment. Host-side only; no RKNN/board claim.

export.expected_output_layout: (1, 8, 8400) = [cx, cy, w, h, class_score, kpt_x, kpt_y, kpt_conf]

verification.raw_relative_note: absolute max diff is dominated by the coordinate channels whose values span 0..640; 0.001 relative = 0.64 input px. The old 1.22e-4 was an absolute max on the untrained smoke graph; on the trained checkpoint the absolute max is larger while the relative difference stays ~1e-4.
verification.note: the exported graph is accepted only if the raw torch and onnxruntime outputs agree within atol on the same preprocessed canvas

parity.preprocessing: one shared square center letterbox: auto=False, stride=32, pad=114, imgsz=640; every path consumes the same canvas PNG / float tensor

nms.conf_thres: configurable; default 0.01 so the decode stage applies the frozen tau_det exactly once

parity.coordinate_domain: source pixels of the original image (exact inverse letterbox); image bearing is atan2(x-cx, fx), not a world bearing
parity.thresholds_note: read from the freeze file at run time; the duplicated values here are only a drift guard

tolerances.note: primary parity (pt_square vs onnx_native_square vs raw_ort_square) must have zero decision flips; legacy preprocessing mismatch (rect vs square) is reported, not asserted

sample_policy.final_pool_usage: read-only sample; no metrics run, no threshold/label change, no new final evaluation; the one-shot exploratory final already happened and is not rerun

environment_pins.note: the Isaac venv stays untouched; the isolated .venv/landmark-train is used for the run

license_and_usage.license_route: internal bounded research authorised by the user on 2026-11-04; distribution undecided; AGPL obligations unresolved; this is not a legal conclusion
license_and_usage.usage_boundary: host-side parity evidence only; no RK3576/board, no accuracy certification, no navigation/Gate claim
